before.text: One choice is still open: whether passengers keep their fare on next-day sailings after a weather cancellation. Option 1, same day only with next day case by case, is what the decision in [[slack:C0FW1WEATHR-1788444000.000100]] says. Option 2, next day too, is only proposed: the later reply says ops agreed, but nobody from ops says so, and [[jira:SYN-45]] hasn't changed since June.
